about_the_game:
Sonya is a dark visual novel of psychological horror and surrealism. You wake up in an old psychiatric hospital with complete memory loss. The walls of this place hold unspoken secrets, and its inhabitants—a cynical staff and patients consumed by their own manias—see you as merely a pawn in their games. Your mind becomes a battlefield where the voice of reason clashes with the whisper of paranoia.

  • DELVE into the depths of the labyrinth, wandering through floors full of hidden passages, grim secrets, and dangerous inhabitants.

  • INTERACT with unreliable characters, whose words could be the truth or just a product of your sick imagination.

  • MAKE decisions that influence the plot, your karma, and your reputation. Will you save others, or save only yourself?

  • CREATE your hero. Distribute skill points and choose your own path: will you be a strong-willed leader, a perceptive detective, a nimble sneak, or a flattering manipulator?

  • TRUST your instinct. Inner voices offer advice, but only you can decide who to believe—reason or the call of the darkness.

Make your choice. Before it's too late.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game does not contain visual sexual content or explicit scenes.

However, the story deals with mature themes, including implications of sexual violence in dialogues and character backstories. The game also features scenes of physical violence, blood, and the dark atmosphere of a psychiatric clinic.
